column2: # One reusable builder, called once per day-3 arm.
#   baseline points/lines/error bars live near x = 1 (within +/- 0.08)
#   arm      points/lines/error bars live near x = 2 (within +/- 0.08)
#   baseline box sits at x = 0.60, arm box at x = 2.40 (width 0.22)
# so the boxes are always clear of the point clusters and the connecting lines.
# Coloring: baseline points/box in baseline blue; arm points/box in the arm color;
# connecting lines neutral grey so they read as links rather than adding new colors.
# The control arm gets a panel too. Whether it shows connecting lines depends on whether
# the day-3 control animals' own baseline threads have been curated with a plaque area;
# the pair count is printed for every panel so an empty pairing is never silent.
ctrl <- baseline_pool %>% mutate(side = "control", xbase = 1, xbox = box_ctrl_x)
# Day-0 lab-reference animals as their own cluster at the far left (x = 0). They are a
# descriptive group only: never pooled with the baseline, never paired, never modelled.
mutate(side = "lab", xbase = 0, xbox = box_lab_x) else per_mussel_means[0, ]
warning("No day-3 threads for arm '", trt_code, "'; panel skipped.", call. = FALSE)
# Connecting lines only for mussels present on both sides (true repeated measures).
" paired to a baseline", if (show_lab) paste0("; ", nrow(lab), " lab-reference animals shown") else "", ".")
x_labels <- if (show_lab) c("lab\n(day 0)", "baseline", trt_label) else c("baseline", trt_label)
aes(x = xpos, ymin = adh_mean - adh_se, ymax = adh_mean + adh_se),
aes(x = xpos, y = adh_mean), size = 3, color = lab_col) } +
aes(x = xpos, y = adh_mean), size = 3, shape = 1, stroke = 0.6, color = "black") } +
aes(x = xpos, y = adh_mean, group = mussel),
aes(x = xpos, ymin = adh_mean - adh_se, ymax = adh_mean + adh_se),
aes(x = xpos, y = adh_mean), size = 3, color = base_col) +
aes(x = xpos, y = adh_mean), size = 3, shape = 1, stroke = 0.6, color = "black") +
aes(x = xpos, ymin = adh_mean - adh_se, ymax = adh_mean + adh_se),
aes(x = xpos, y = adh_mean), size = 3, color = trt_col) +
aes(x = xpos, y = adh_mean), size = 3, shape = 1, stroke = 0.6, color = "black") +
scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, labels = x_labels, limits = x_limits) +
# Build a panel for every day-3 arm actually present in the data.
pnl <- make_line_box(arm, trt_label = if (arm == "treatment_control") "control" else arm)
fn <- if (arm %in% names(panel_files)) panel_files[[arm]] else paste0("LineBox_", arm, ".png")
